about_the_game:
A nostalgic point-and-click adventure game inspired by the classics!

A story filled with humor and emotion, coupled with interesting puzzles that evoke nostalgia, laughter and thought.

Play as the naive Eddie, a metalhead who seems a bit lost in life, guide him through a mysterious, ruined but still beautiful world.

Meet interesting, weird and funny characters, find what you've lost or lose what you've found.

  • Story: Follow Eddie on his strange, humorous, but also somber journey to find answers in this nostalgic point-and-click adventure.

  • World: A strange yet familiar place, that holds mysteries for you and Eddie to unwrap.

  • Original Soundtrack: Composed with themes and selected instruments to enhance the gameplay and story.

  • Voice Acting: 100% voiced for your immersion.

  • Pixel Art: Using a similar resolution to the classics and turning the old limitations of the past into stylistic choices.

  • Interface: Inspired by the classics with all the verbs one could ever need!

  • Puzzles: That make sense, mostly. Just kidding, they totally make sense.
